intent: Build the synthesis order list for these oligos: keep one copy of each distinct oligo sequence. The top-strand and bottom-strand oligo of each adaptor are different molecules, and both must be ordered.
silent_error: 'seqkit rmdup -s' compares sequences on both strands unless -P/--only-positive-strand is given (this is stated in its help). Every bottom-strand oligo is the reverse complement of its top-strand oligo, so the default treats it as a duplicate and deletes it; only one oligo per adaptor survives. seqkit exits 0 and logs only '[INFO] 9 duplicated records removed' (the file has just 3 exact repeats), which reads like normal deduplication.
